subject.title: fix(auth-profiles): preserve secret refs and OAuth fields during doctor auth migration

question: Should auth/security owners accept this credential-field preservation behavior for legacy auth-store migration and land the PR, or require broader shipped-shape coverage or coordination with related auth migration work first?
rationale: The code path handles provider auth material, SecretRefs, and OAuth refresh fields during upgrade cleanup, so the remaining choice is owner acceptance of the credential migration boundary rather than a mechanical patch defect.

options.title: Land after auth/security owner pass
options.body: Accept the focused parser-reuse fix and merge after the normal exact-head checks because both affected migration writers are covered by before/after proof.

options.title: Add broader shipped-shape fixtures first
options.body: Ask for one or more fixtures from known shipped auth-store shapes before merge if maintainers want lower upgrade uncertainty.

options.title: Coordinate with related migration PRs
options.body: Pause only if maintainers want this field-preservation patch bundled or sequenced with the separate data-loss repairs in the auth migration cluster.

recommendation.title: Land after auth/security owner pass
recommendation.body: Accept the focused parser-reuse fix and merge after the normal exact-head checks because both affected migration writers are covered by before/after proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the original flat auth doctor migration and SQLite auth-profile refactor history on the touched files, making him the best available decision router for the migration boundary.
